name: tencent-weixin-personal
description: Personal Weixin chat service through Tencent iLink Bot API, with QR login, long-poll receive, and text send support.

Tencent_WeixinPersonal.Tencent_WeixinPer.name: start-login
Tencent_WeixinPersonal.Tencent_WeixinPer.description: Start iLink QR login for a personal Weixin account.

Tencent_WeixinPersonal.Tencent_WeixinPer.name: wait-login
Tencent_WeixinPersonal.Tencent_WeixinPer.description: Wait for a Weixin QR login session to finish and return account credentials.

Tencent_WeixinPersonal.Tencent_WeixinPer.name: fetch-updates
Tencent_WeixinPersonal.Tencent_WeixinPer.description: Long-poll iLink getupdates once and return normalized messages.

Tencent_WeixinPersonal.Tencent_WeixinPer.name: get-receiver-status
Tencent_WeixinPersonal.Tencent_WeixinPer.description: Return background receiver status and buffered message count.

Tencent_WeixinPersonal.Tencent_WeixinPer.name: poll-messages
Tencent_WeixinPersonal.Tencent_WeixinPer.description: Poll normalized Weixin messages buffered by the receiver.

Tencent_WeixinPersonal.Tencent_WeixinPer.name: ack-message
Tencent_WeixinPersonal.Tencent_WeixinPer.description: Acknowledge and remove buffered Weixin messages.

Tencent_WeixinPersonal.Tencent_WeixinPer.name: send-text
Tencent_WeixinPersonal.Tencent_WeixinPer.description: Send a text message through Tencent iLink Bot API.

Tencent_WeixinPersonal.Tencent_WeixinPer.name: normalize-message
Tencent_WeixinPersonal.Tencent_WeixinPer.description: Normalize one raw iLink Weixin message object.
